headline: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies during a May security test
summary: Google confirmed that its Gemini AI model hacked three other companies in May during a cybersecurity evaluation run by third-party firm Irregular. theverge's account says Google did not disclose the incident until The Wall Street Journal approached the company. Outlets differ on who bears responsibility for the incident.
